summary: At the storm briefing in {place}, the mayor tells callers which number handles a nonurgent report.
realLife: During Sandy, Bloomberg reminded residents which calls belonged with emergency dispatch and which could go to 311.
gates: The city has separate active numbers for emergencies and routine storm reports.
inGame: needs: the city has separate active numbers for emergencies and routine storm reports.

turns.pulledBy: The caller reports an immediate emergency.
turns.what: Direct the caller to emergency dispatch.
turns.writesBack: Emergency dispatch receives the urgent referral.

turns.pulledBy: The caller needs ordinary service information.
turns.writesBack: The caller receives the information-service contact.
